name: app/stat-tile
title: StatTile
summary: One headline figure: a label, the value, an optional trend in words and a note. A missing value reads "Not available", never 0.

props.name: value
props.description: The figure; numbers are formatted for `locale`. Null, undefined or "" reads "Not available".

props.name: trend
props.description: Change against the previous period: per cent, or points with `points`.

props.name: points
props.description: The trend is in percentage points.

props.name: upIsGood
props.description: Whether a rise is good news; only the tone changes.

props.name: versus
props.description: What the trend is compared with ("the previous 30 days").

props.name: info
props.description: What the figure counts, as an InfoTip after the label.

behaviour: A <div> holding <dt> (label) and <dd> (value, trend, note), so it sits in a <dl>.

The trend is said once, in words, to screen readers ("Up 12.5% on the previous 30 days", "No change"); the visible badge is short and never wraps ("+12.5%"), with "vs …" after it. Never colour or an arrow alone.
Good news is malachite, bad news terracotta, and both are status colours that never follow the brand.

keyboard: The InfoTip button, when `info` is set.
aria: Trend text carries the meaning; colour is redundant.

theming.brandOverlay: None. Trend tones are status colours (malachite good, terracotta bad) and are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Fills its grid cell; the value never wraps mid-number (tabular figures).
contract:
contract
  slot is "stat-tile"
  when default shows dd "1,240"
  when default shows dd "Up 12.5% on the previous 30 days"
  when missing shows dd "Not available"
  uses info-tip
end

checks.say: A fall that is good news is green, and still said as a fall.
Screen readers hear the trend once, in words.
The short badge is visual only and never wraps.
